subject: Parallax pilot — burn profile, unit-cost checkpoints and invoice sketch
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@parallax.health>, Parallax Finance <finance@parallax.health>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 04 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Parallax pilot — burn profile, unit-cost checkpoints and invoice sketch

Hi Elena — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and a proposed next step so we can get Procurement moving.

Call highlights / assumptions (please confirm):
- Primary use: in-product conversational assistant (generation-heavy) + periodic embeddings for search.
- Expected pilot window: 3 months.
- Estimated active users during pilot: 12k MAU (ramp to that over 4 weeks).
- Average prompts per active user per month: 25 (mix of short prompts + 1 long context reply).
- Avg tokens: 450 request / 650 response (generation-heavy). Embeddings calls ~1.2M/month.

Preliminary volume estimate (monthly):
- Generation requests: ~300k prompts => ~135M input tokens + ~195M output tokens => ~330M tokens/month.
- Embeddings: ~1.2M embedding vectors/month (small vectors).

What this maps to for unit economics (ballpark):
- If billed at $1,100 / 1M gen-tokens (on-demand, no commit) => ~$363,000 / month for generation tokens.
- With smart caching (prefix/KV) and a reserved pilot commit (modest 3-month commitment) we can often reduce effective cost 20–35% depending on hit-rate.
- Embeddings are typically a separate line item — rough estimate $0.45 / 1k embeddings (so ~ $540 / month for embeddings at 1.2M).

Immediate asks / next steps:
1) Can you confirm the MAU and average prompts assumptions (or share any telemetry you have)?
2) Is Parallax comfortable with a pilot cap (e.g., $75k / month) while we prove hit rates & prefix caching?
3) Would you prefer an invoice sketch tied to an on-demand rate vs. one that assumes a 3-month reserved commit (we can show both).

I've attached an initial estimate spreadsheet (parallax_estimate_v1.xlsx) with a simple calculator — Ben and Laura are looped in to formalize a pilot invoice if you want us to move forward.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0193
Redwood Inference

From: Elena Rossi <elena@parallax.health>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Parallax Finance <finance@parallax.health>
Date: Tue, 04 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Parallax pilot — burn profile, unit-cost checkpoints and invoice sketch

Thanks, Aditya — nice summary. A few clarifications from our side:

- MAU: target for pilot is closer to 8–10k (we’ll probably hit 10k by week 6).
- Prompts: 20–30 per MAU/month is right; long-tail prompts will push the average tokens up a bit, so your 450/650 split is reasonable.
- Embeddings: confirmed ~1.2M/month (used for search ranking).
- Budget: procurement asked for a conservative target of <$1,000 per 1M tokens as an initial threshold; they’ll review higher with a committed discount.

Please send a conservative invoice sketch (3-month pilot, capped at $90k/month) and one alternative that shows the effect of a 3-month reserved commit at a discounted unit price. Finance needs explicit line items for generation vs embeddings and any one-time enablement fees.

Elena
Elena Rossi
Head of Product Operations, Parallax Health
elena@parallax.health

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 05 May 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Parallax — conservative invoice sketches + unit cost calculator (attached)

Elena — attaching two invoice sketches and the unit_cost_calculator.csv that maps your telemetry to monthly spend. I kept the language Finance asked for: separate line items for generation, embeddings, and any one-time onboarding/enablement.

Summary of options (generation tokens only):
- Option A — On-demand: $1,100 / 1M gen-tokens. No commit. Estimated spend (330M gen tokens/mo): ~$363,000 / month.
- Option B — Pilot reserved (3-month modest commit): $850 / 1M gen-tokens (assumes 20% effective caching hit on generation). Estimated spend (after hit-rate): ~$270,000 / month.
- Option C — Enterprise pilot (3-month + 12-month commitment path): $650 / 1M gen-tokens (requires commitment + dedicated pool). Estimated spend (after caching): ~$207,000 / month.

Example invoice sketches included in parallax_estimate_v2.xlsx:
- Conservative cap: 3-month pilot capped at $90k/month (redline shows how caching + rate discount would be applied).
- Mid-path: Pilot commit of $150k/month (higher throughput, lower per-M tokens).

Important notes:
- The numbers above are intentionally conservative on caching hit rates — we recommend a small initial pilot commit to measure actual hit-rate and then apply adjustments.
- Embeddings are listed as a separate line item in the sheet (estimated at ~$540/mo given 1.2M embeddings).

Links & attachments:
- parallax_estimate_v2.xlsx (detailed invoice sketches)
- unit_cost_calculator.csv (token-volume to invoice mapping)
- redwood-pilot-sla-summary.pdf (SLA + support matrix for Dedicated vs Hosted)
- Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C_parallax_estimates

If Finance confirms a cap target ($90k/mo) we can produce a short MOU for signature and schedule a kickoff to enable caching strategies and tracing hooks.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0124

Attachments: parallax_estimate_v2.xlsx, unit_cost_calculator.csv, redwood-pilot-sla-summary.pdf
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 06 May 2027 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: internal: Parallax pricing guardrails

Quick internal — looping to confirm negotiation posture before we send the MOU.

- Procurement asked for <$1,000 / 1M as a starting point. We shouldn't give that on the standard on-demand SKU.
- Approve up to $850 / 1M for a 3-month pilot if Parallax agrees to a $25k non-refundable enablement retainer (applied to first invoice) and a $50k minimum spend over the 3 months.
- If Legal wants a special SLA clause or additional compliance evidence (SOC2 artifact), we can add a short appendix but that will push the lead time.

Aditya — if Parallax accepts the $25k retainer + $50k 3-month floor, proceed to draft the MOU and copy me. Ben — please prepare a one-page breakdown (customer-facing) that translates the commitment into effective $/1M tokens at 3 hit-rate scenarios (10/20/30% cache hits).

Thanks — Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
